title: 조기진급 등에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1

Article 4 (Criteria and Procedures for Granting Qualifications for Early Admission to Schools of Higher Level)
(1) The head of a school at any level may grant a student wishing to enter a school of higher level early the qualifications for early admission to that higher-level school pursuant to Article 27 (1) of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act, irrespective of whether the student has been selected as a candidate for early promotion or graduation.
(2) When granting qualifications for early admission to a school of higher level under paragraph (1), the head of the school shall comply with the standards prescribed by the superintendent of education concerning the following matters:
1. Academic achievement;
2. Admission screening standards or plans established by the head of a school of higher level pursuant to Article 66 (2) or 78 of the Enforcement Decree of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act or Article 33 of the Enforcement Decree of the Higher Education Act.
(3) When granting qualifications for early admission under paragraph (1), the head of the school shall obtain an assessment by the Committee for Evaluation of Early Promotion, Graduation and Admission under Article 5 (1).
(4) Detailed procedures and methods necessary to grant qualifications for early admission to schools of higher level shall be determined by the head of each school in its school rules.
